How it works

Three simple steps to faster authorizations.

Mindscale AI does the coverage research, the criteria check, and the documentation, helping submissions go out complete the first time.
1

Understand Coverage Requirements

Click to submit patient and procedure information through our streamlined interface

Coverage Intelligence
Make sure to cover these criteria in your SOAP notes and treatment plan.
Patient must meet all of the following:
  • Therapy with Contrave will NOT be combined with other weight loss agents.
  • Patient has NO FDA-labeled contraindications to Contrave.
2

Evaluate Medical Necessity

Our AI validates against payer criteria and clinical guidelines instantly

Medical Necessity Review
Today
Requesting lumbar laminectomy for the management of the herniated lumbar disc for patient.
Aetna Policy 2134 has been identified. We are evaluating the patient's clinical data against the policy criteria.
Result: Your patient meets the medical necessity requirements for the highlighted criteria for Aetna Policy 123. The generated medical documentation contains detail justifications for each criteria that has been met.
